title: Pangilinan urges national state of emergency over Super El Niño

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan on Wednesday urged the government to declare a national state of emergency in response to the adverse effects of the Super El Niño. Pangilinan made the call during a Senate hearing on the Department of Agriculture’s (DA) proposed P171.3-billion budget. In his opening statement, Pangilinan noted that the country has already suffered P6.87 in drought losses as of Sept. 26, not yet even including the actual effects of the current El Niño.
